definitions.explanation: Thoroughly secured or tightly controlled, leaving no gaps or vulnerabilities. Commonly describes security measures, guarding, warnings, and protective arrangements.

examples.japanese: {厳重|げんじゅう}な⟦{警備|けいび}→警備：00208_keibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{敷|し}かれた→敷く：00366_shiku⟧。
examples.english: Tight security was put in place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金庫|きんこ}→金庫：01749_kinko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厳重|げんじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The safe is kept under strict security.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厳重|げんじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}→保管：11442_hokan⟧し、⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漏|も}れない→漏れる：02435_moreru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Personal information is stored under tight security to prevent any leaks.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厳重|げんじゅう}な⟦{警備|けいび}→警備：00208_keibi⟧ (tight security)
- {厳重|げんじゅう}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧ (stern warning)
- {厳重|げんじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧ (store securely)
- {厳重|げんじゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{管理|かんり}する→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧ (manage strictly)

Focuses on thoroughness of security and protection, unlike ⟦{厳格|げんかく}→厳格：11886_genkaku⟧ (strict regarding people/discipline) or ⟦{厳密|げんみつ}→厳密：11885_genmitsu⟧ (precise, exact). Often appears in news about security operations, police activities, and data protection.
